primary_source_summary.summary: The pinned kernel declares ERESTARTNOINTR=513. copy_process can return its negative before allocating a child; kernel_clone propagates the error before fork notification/wakeup. Syscall-exit tracing precedes signal handling; x86 restart paths restore original AX and rewind IP. Pinned GDB all-stop handling can reset syscall labels or consume intervening traps. The adapter therefore preserves one bounded token without assuming a visible restarted entry or opposite label.
primary_source_summary.trust_limits: Previously reviewed official TLS tag reads and installed package/header identity; no fresh network here, signed source-package verification, byte-identical kernel rebuild or running-kernel source attestation. Historical pending signal identity/GDB stopping flag were not captured; GDB all-stop SIGSTOP is a source-supported inference, not an observed cause.
